description: Default scoring configuration. Two layers: the owner score (owner_weights, owner_thresholds; fundamentals and shareholder agents) decides BUY/HOLD/SELL on a 12-month horizon and does not depend on the regime. The timing panel (regime_weights, thresholds; trend, volume, options, pullback) is summarized as favorable/neutral/unfavorable for entry timing and sizing and has no vote. Since D-40 (October 2026) the shipped timing profile is the same in every regime and gives the macro agent 0, because per-regime profiles and the market-wide macro score added nothing in or out of sample; the regime is shown as a market risk reading. The timing cut-offs (FAVORABLE at +6.1, UNFAVORABLE at -40) keep the label's shares where they were. Weights are relative: each profile is renormalized over the agents that are enabled and have data. Edit from the Weights tab (saved to data/store/agent_weights.json) or here to change the shipped defaults.
roles_note: roles: agent_key -> owner (decides), timing (informs, no vote) or info (shown, not scored). Empty means each agent keeps its class role. An agent moved to a new layer starts at weight 0 there. agent_order and layer_order set the display order only.
